title: Cohomology properties of maps in (Cat) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is the tail of a table of contents or programme for the theory of basic localizers that the previous page sets up. On the previous page the sections are: ⓪ the localizer axioms Loc 1–3, including fibrations and cofibrations; ① duality (W = W°); ② comments on fibrations, cofibrations, cylinders and cones; ③ a homotopy-pushout construction ∫(X_1 ← Y → X_0); ④ a 'theorem of the amalgamated sum' for compactifying cofibrations, with its application to pushouts along immersions in Â; and the start of ⑤, 'Hot(W) and Hot_A, computation of derived functors (limits?) in Cat and Â'.

This page finishes that item. The plan is to apply the machinery to sums and products in Hot_W (the localization of Cat at a basic localizer W) and in Hot_A = Â[W_A^{-1}], for A a *local test category*. The mathematical content intended is standard in modern language:
- Sums. For any basic localizer, W is stable under small coproducts. Hence Cat → Hot_W preserves sums.
- Products. W is stable under finite products (an aspherical-map / Quillen Theorem A argument). Hence Cat → Hot_W preserves finite products.
- Presheaves. For A a local test category, W_A = i_A^{-1}(W) is stable under sums. When A is a test category, so that Â is a model of Hot_W, the induced functors on homotopy categories commute with sums. Finite products are preserved under the further asphericity hypotheses (strict, or aspherical-product, test categories).

The next section, renumbered ⑤ after crossing out 'Propriétés…', is 'Interprétations fortes des W, des W_A'. The most plausible reading is a characterization of W and W_A by a homotopical (Hom-in-Hot) criterion. That is, W is strongly saturated: a map is in W iff it becomes invertible in Hot_W, perhaps tested on maps into or out of aspherical objects. Alternatively it is the 'Yoneda-type' interpretation of weak equivalences.

The bottom of the page carries a crossed-out word and an 'R' marker; the rest is blank. The next page starts a new topic: recollements of a category X along a sieve/cosieve decomposition U ⊂ X ⊃ Y with bimodule H_X : U°×Y → Ens. That is not continued here.
